text:
Alyssa (People Ops): New: Emergency Quarantine & Relocation Support policy is live for company-approved travel. Effective now. Details + claim form: https://redwood.atlassian.org/people-ops/travel/quarantine-support-2026

Ops-Safety-Bot: Checklist added: pre-trip risk assessment, emergency contact, documentation required for claims. Use /travel-check to flag.

Marcus Nguyen: Quick q: covers return flights if borders close?

Alyssa (People Ops): Economy return covered when recommended by Ops-Safety or required by advisories. Upgrades only for medical/ops reasons with sign-off.

Sofia Romero: How many nights covered for quarantine?

Alyssa (People Ops): Up to 14 consecutive nights per event at a reasonable local rate; exceptions reviewed case-by-case.

Finance-Team: For claims we need itemized receipts, proof of quarantine (notice/email/public link), and travel request ID. Submit "Quarantine Support" claim type.

Marcus Nguyen: What about dependents on the same booking?

Alyssa (People Ops): Not automatically covered unless contractor/vendor or contract requires it. Submit details for review.

Sofia Romero: Timeline for reimbursement? Some folks front costs.

Finance-Team: Submit within 5 business days after return. Use "URGENT-QUARANTINE" in subject for expedited review (3-7 business days typical).

Alyssa (People Ops): I'll run a 15-min drop-in tomorrow 09:30 PT in #people-ops-office-hours and post a short checklist in the policy doc. DM me for urgent help. :thumbsup:

Marcus Nguyen: Thanks, super helpful.

Sofia Romero: Appreciate it.
